description: This file defines the HeadlinesFragment class, a fragment responsible for displaying a list of news headlines within an Android application. It manages a list adapter, handles user interactions such as clicks on headlines, and communicates selections via a listener interface.

classes.name: HeadlinesFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a list of news headlines and handles user interactions with them.

classes.name: OnHeadlineSelectedListener
classes.description: Interface for a callback to notify when a headline is selected.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Initializes the list adapter and sets the item click listener when the fragment starts.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the list adapter with context and layout.

methods.name: setOnHeadlineSelectedListener
methods.description: Sets the listener that will be notified when a headline is selected.

methods.name: loadCategory
methods.description: Loads headlines for a specified news category.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles click events on list items and notifies the listener.

methods.name: setSelectable
methods.description: Sets whether the list allows selection.
